course.title: Aerospace Engineering BEng (Hons) | University of Nottingham
quotes: Duration 3 years full-time Location University Park Campus Select start date September 2027
The entrance requirements listed apply to 2027 entry.
A levels AAA IB 34 points overall
IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element)
Required subjects A in maths and either physics or further maths, or any two of the following: chemistry, biology, design, electronics.

IB score 34 points overall or 666 in 3 Higher Level Certificates. IB requirements 6 in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches at HL or 6 in Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation at HL or 7 in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches at SL plus 6 in Physics at HL or 7 in Physics at SL.
